verdict.rationale: Workable documents in-product AI suggestions: AI-generated candidate recommendations based on your job ad, and the Workable Agent, which screens and qualifies candidates against the spec and returns a shortlist. These are recruiting-specific suggestions. There is no evidence of AI insights generated across your broader account data. missing for 10: AI-driven analytics or insights over your own hiring data (the custom report builder is not described as AI), conversational or ad-hoc querying of your data, detail on how the Agent's qualification reasoning is surfaced, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Receive AI-generated recommendations of qualified candidates based on your job ad from a pool of 400 million profiles.
The Workable Agent runs the top of the funnel - sourcing, screening and qualifying every candidate against the spec - and hands your team an interview-ready shortlist.
Search yourself or use AI to find qualified candidates that match your specific requirements.
